news.title: BAJFINANCE: Higher Margins And Dividend Outlook Will Support Future Upside
news.body: Analysts have trimmed their price target on Bajaj Finance by about ₹20 to roughly ₹1,059. This reflects updated views on fair value that balance a slightly different revenue growth outlook, an adjusted discount rate, a higher profit margin assumption and a lower future P/E multiple.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹30.60 (up from ₹26.89 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹438.3b (up 18% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹190.2b (up 14% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 43% (down from 45% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Revenue was in line with analyst estimates. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 1.2%. Revenue is forecast to grow 24% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 15% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 14% per year.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: EPS misses analyst expectations
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.40 (down from ₹6.85 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹138.8b (up 44% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹39.8b (down 6.3% from 3Q 2025). Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 43%. Revenue is forecast to grow 25% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 23% growth forecast for the Consumer Finance industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 16% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 15% per year.

news.body: Analysts have raised their price target on Bajaj Finance from ₹1,150 to ₹1,329, citing slightly faster expected revenue growth and a higher anticipated future P/E multiple, which more than offset a modest reduction in projected profit margins and discount rate. What's in the News Promoter Bajaj Finance may sell a 2% stake in Bajaj Housing Finance via a block deal on 2 December 2025, with around 166 million shares on offer at a likely floor price of INR 95 per share, about a 9% discount to the prior close.
